stances.claim: Ten weeks after the LCT injections, Dr. Dennis Serrano confirmed CJ's prostate cancer cells were 'inactive' and PSA had dropped to 0.33 -- Duodart intake reduced and hormone treatment canceled.
stances.rhetorical_move: Empirical-personal report grounded in named physician's evaluation.

stances.claim: LCT healing is genuine but uneven -- robust on lumbar pain (ceased since July), tennis/golf swings, and capacity for 30-minute nonstop waltz/tango/swing; only modest on carpal tunnel and varicose veins.
stances.rhetorical_move: Even-handed effect catalog distinguishing strong from weak responses.

stances.claim: The mystery of stem cells likely connects to the CRISPR-Cas9 framework -- Doudna's Nobel-winning ability to 'cut out defective parts of a person's genome and insert new ones' is analogous to stem cells' natural ability 'to stimulate, revitalize, and restore the patient's weakened tissues and organs.'
stances.rhetorical_move: Speculative bridge between cell therapy and gene editing, qualified as 'to my mind.'

stances.claim: The deeper mystery is the zygote -- 'the fertilization of the egg by the sperm and the resulting zygote's ability to divide itself and grow rapidly into different body parts without human intervention' -- and this is the work only God can create and unravel.
stances.rhetorical_move: Theological framing closure: science deepens, rather than replaces, the mystery of life.

notable_anecdotes.description: Block farm operational protocol: 2,500 cancer-resistant black sheep roam a 25-square-kilometer jungle-like farm in Landsberg; the clinic specifically selects first-time mother black sheep; 70 sheep are chosen initially for every patient batch; 20 are quarantined a week before treatment; 2-3 days prior, two of the best are slaughtered; the embryo's parts are emulsified within 40 minutes in an EU-certified laboratory and brought in measured syringes to specific patients. Healing is sometimes 'instant' but normally takes 4-10 weeks.
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Industrial-process documentation that demystifies LCT logistics.

notable_anecdotes.description: CJ's Oct. 23 follow-up evaluation by Dr. Dennis Serrano: prostate cancer cells 'inactive,' PSA at an 'incredibly low 0.33'; hormone treatment canceled; Duodart reduced to twice a week; lumbar pain has not recurred since July; tennis and golf swings 'more robust'; able to 'walk briskly, and waltz, tango and swing nonstop for 30 minutes.'
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Concrete empirical-clinical confirmation of the personal healing claims.

notable_anecdotes.description: CJ's post-LCT regimen: intermittent fasting to keep weight below 70 kilos; gym + tennis Mondays/Fridays; golf Wednesdays/Saturdays; brisk walks at the Manila Polo oval Tuesdays/Thursdays; home treadmill Sundays. Plus a five-point lifelong commitment: stimulate the brain, attend 100% of board/committee meetings, mediate disputes among corporate and political giants, socialize/travel/dine/laugh with family, and write columns at 100% attendance.
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Personal-discipline catalog showing 'rejuvenation' translated into routine.

notable_anecdotes.description: Self-citation from his 2003 book 'The Bio-age Dawns on the Judiciary' on the April 14, 2003 completion of the human genome sequence: 'It is as if all the parts of an airplane have been inventoried, thereby presaging the inevitability of assembling them into a new flying machine or... of scientifically repairing a worn-out one.'
notable_anecdotes.purpose: Establishes CJ's two-decade engagement with biotech jurisprudence as the through-line for his current stem-cell interest.

notable_anecdotes.description: Closing devotional paraphrase: 'To God be the glory!' and from St. Augustine, 'My heart had been restless till it rested in Christ Jesus.'

one_paragraph_summary: The capstone to CJ Panganiban's four-part stem-cell series summarizes his German clinic observations, reports his own post-LCT healing, and ventures a philosophical bridge between cell science and theology. Operationally, the Block Clinic descends from Dr. Paul Niehans (1931 LCT founder) through Dr. Siegfried Block, daughter Dr. Petra Block (current medical director), and grandson Dr. Daniel Block (administrative director), with a reported 86 percent healing rate; 2,500 cancer-resistant black sheep roam a 25-square-kilometer farm in Landsberg; first-time-mother sheep are selected, 70 initially per patient batch, 20 quarantined a week before treatment, and 2-3 best slaughtered 2-3 days prior with embryo parts emulsified within 40 minutes in an EU-certified laboratory. The empirical-clinical confirmation came at CJ's Oct. 23 evaluation by Dr. Dennis Serrano: prostate cancer cells 'inactive,' PSA at 0.33, hormone treatment canceled, Duodart reduced to twice a week; lumbar pain had not recurred since July; tennis and golf swings 'more robust'; CJ could waltz, tango, and swing nonstop for 30 minutes -- with only modest improvement to carpal tunnel and varicose veins. He commits to an explicit regimen -- intermittent fasting under 70 kilos, gym/tennis Mon-Fri, golf Wed-Sat, Manila Polo oval brisk walks Tue-Thu, Sunday treadmill -- plus a five-point lifelong engagement plan (brain stimulation, 100% board/committee attendance, mediation among corporate and political giants, socializing/traveling/dining/laughing with family, and writing his columns at 100%). Reaching back to his 2003 book 'The Bio-age Dawns on the Judiciary,' written around the April 14, 2003 completion of the human genome sequence, he speculates that stem-cell mystery may share mechanism with Jennifer Doudna's Nobel-winning CRISPR-Cas9 gene-editing -- the ability to revitalize weakened tissues by 'natural' analogues to 'cutting out defective parts of a person's genome and inserting new ones.' He closes with a deeper mystery -- the zygote's self-organizing growth from a single cell -- and an Augustinian doxology: 'To God be the glory! My heart had been restless till it rested in Christ Jesus.'
